offset_note: Cron targets are rendered from a fixed EST offset. During EDT each job fires one hour later in local terms. The VOI watch polls three times a day, which absorbs that; the monthly scan does not care.

jobs.description: Full sweep of every enabled source on the first of the month.
jobs.rationale: Runs the day after DCSA's month-end publication target, so a VOI released on the last day of the month is picked up within about a day even if the release watch missed it.

jobs.description: Poll the Voice of Industry home three times a day across the month-end release window.
jobs.rationale: DCSA targets month-end but slips: observed issues are dated 260130, 260227 and 260331, and the March issue surfaced around 2 April. The exact release date is not knowable in advance, so the window is polled rather than a single date scheduled. The window closes only on a finding matching `expect` - an unrelated document posted mid-window must not end the polling before the awaited issue is published.
